_note: Which RiseUp row feeds which of Eden's Personal Categories. Committed rather than
stored in the database so that a changed subscription shows up in a git diff and a
Rules and identities only — never an amount. Every sequenceId below was read off the
charges of 2026-09 and is the same across months: an envelope's own id changes every
month, which is why it is never the key.
Eden's file is the one that needs label rules. RiseUp keeps one חשבונות category where
her grid has five rows, and RiseUp's own label on each charge is exactly the row name —
שיק for the rent cheque, ארנונה, מים, חשמל, גז. A label rule wins over a category rule
and reaches into the other-spending bucket too, which is how a rent cheque that landed
in the bucket still reaches שכ"ד. There is deliberately no category rule for חשבונות:
a charge in it that no label claims is an unresolved row, not a guess.
RiseUp's רפואי ופארם has no row in her 2026 grid, so it is left unmapped and prints as
unresolved. Proposing it as a new Personal Category is --map's job (Phase 34), and this
Her אוכל APPLE, Tello/Skype and אינטרנט rows are blank all year and are absent here
rather than marked hand-typed: which of her rows really has no RiseUp source is settled
against the database by --map, not read off the sheet export.
